{{Top|leg}}
A '''wideband transceiver''' was a communications device. [[Rodian D-Tec]] [[RHTC-560 Hunter Trainer]]s and [[RHTC-560 HT Drone]]s were equipped with wideband transceivers that allowed them to transmit and receive communication signals. The transceivers were equipped with typical [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] frequencies.
